data.title: 小鞠知花 · 图书馆书架前踮脚被环抱
data.description: 安静的学校图书馆深处，知花踮起脚尖够不到高处的书本。当你从她身后伸出手取下书本并几乎将她整个人圈在怀里时，少女背脊僵住，双耳红透，小鹿乱撞地回头。
data.location: narrow quiet library aisle lined with tall wooden bookshelves
data.action: reaching for a high book on tiptoes, partner reaches from behind encircling her, turning back with crimson ears and wide shy doe eyes
data.lighting: soft diffused daylight filtering through tall library windows
data.mood: breathless close proximity, sweet library encounter, adorable small girlfriend gap
data.promptProse: In a quiet library aisle reaching for a book on tiptoes, Chika Komari turns with crimson ears as partner embraces her from behind to help.
data.animaCaption: Chika Komari blushing with partner helping her reach book in library.
